name: @along/aico
description: Aico — AI-powered development workbench integrating requirements, coding, and testing

scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:bridge
scripts.build:bridge: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');function cpDir(src,dest){fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(src,{withFileTypes:true})){const s=p.join(src,e.name),d=p.join(dest,e.name);e.isDirectory()?cpDir(s,d):fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}}const d=p.join('dist','bridge');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(p.join('src','bridge','claude-bridge.mjs'),p.join(d,'claude-bridge.mjs'));const t=p.join('dist','templates');fs.mkdirSync(t,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(p.join('templates','task-split-effort-template.xlsx'),p.join(t,'task-split-effort-template.xlsx'));const sk=p.join('dist','skills');const src=p.join('skills');if(fs.existsSync(src))cpDir(src,sk);"
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux
